problems: Reads as a straw hat, not a planet: the ring is tilted too far toward the camera (k.turn 20 on top of 12° elevation), so it covers the planet's whole lower half and only a dome shows above a brim.
The red stripe sits just above the ring, so it reads as a hatband; on a planet it should be a band of latitude away from the ring.
The ring renders almost white and blown out instead of pale yellow; it needs a warmer, more saturated hex.
The ring is very wide next to the planet (outer radius 2x the planet), so the planet sits small inside a large flat disc; narrow it so the round planet is the main read.

The red band sits proud of the sphere. It has a visible step at its top and bottom edges, so the lower half looks like a separate collar or cup fitted onto the ball, and it no longer reads as one round planet. The band should be a nearly flush stripe on the surface.
The lit upper half of the planet washes out to yellow, close to the pale-yellow ring, so the brief's orange planet does not read. A deeper orange base is needed.
